title: Before and after, one sweep
label: A before and after slider. On the left of a vertical divider, seven customer requests are scattered across email, chat, phone notes, a spreadsheet and social messages, with a counter reading five tools and three hours twenty minutes a day. The divider sweeps to the left edge; each fragment it reaches snaps into its own row in one support queue with a resolved status, and the counter re-reads one tool and ten minutes a day. Then the divider sweeps back.
heading:
Five inboxes.
One queue.
sub: Every email, chat, call and DM becomes a ticket with an owner and a status.
